rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set, after the holdout25 gate failed (short answers wrongly escalated; the prompt clause that mentioned a missing description primed the model to hand off) and the clause was rewritten positively.
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4).
